title: OS command injection: untrusted input reaches a shell command
description: Deterministic detector: taint proves untrusted input reaches a shell command in `app/services/exporter.py`. Evidence line 7: return subprocess.check_output("wkhtmltopdf " + url + " /tmp/o.pdf", shell=True)
attack_chain: Attacker supplies a crafted value via an HTTP request parameter.
The value is concatenated into a shell command (os.system/os.popen/shell=True) with no escaping.
The shell command sink executes the attacker-influenced command at app/services/exporter.py:7.
remediation: Avoid the shell: pass an argument list with shell=False, or escape every argument with shlex.quote(); validate against an allow-list of permitted commands.

taint.proof_basis: Tier-1 taint proven (CWE-78): caller-tainted parameter ``url`` → subprocess.check_output; path across 2 files: app/main.py:55 → app/services/exporter.py:5 → app/services/exporter.py:7; sanitizer missing

evidence.detail: AST confirms a CWE-78 sink-family call near line 7

poc.invocation: Send via the relevant HTTP parameter, e.g. ...?host=127.0.0.1; id #
poc.expected_effect: The injected command executes on the server -> RCE confirmed.

verification.rationale: 3/5 independent signals passed (need 1): grounded, taint_complete, concrete_poc.

title: Server-side template injection (SSTI): untrusted input is compiled as a template
description:
Deterministic detector: Python taint proves untrusted input reaches a ssti sink in `app/main.py`. Evidence line 34: return render_template_string("

" + tpl + "

")
attack_chain: Attacker supplies crafted input via an HTTP request (request.args / request.GET / FastAPI param).
The value flows unsanitised into the query expression.
The expression is evaluated with attacker-controlled syntax at app/main.py:34.
remediation: Never build a template from request input; pass user data as template CONTEXT (variables), never as the template string itself.

taint.proof_basis: Tier-1 taint proven (CWE-1336): HTTP query string → render_template_string; path source@L33 → sink@L34; sanitizer missing

evidence.detail: intraprocedural flow proven in do_preview: HTTP query string -> render_template_string

poc.invocation: Send via the relevant HTTP request field.
poc.expected_effect: Template expression is evaluated server-side -> SSTI -> RCE.

verification.rationale: 3/5 independent signals passed (need 1): grounded, taint_complete, concrete_poc.
